reviewer: Codex, direct image inspection during consolidation 2026-10-02

criteria.observation: The contact sheet uses dark steel and cyan highlights throughout, with amber on cleave, dueling weapons, Eagle Eye and the missile. Resource wood, stone, ingot and crystal silhouettes are distinct.
Each inspected class strip contains five distinct icons and keys. Archer F shows the gold eye and Engineer F the missile; all action names remain beneath the icons.
At 64 px all 23 art silhouettes fit inside their slots. The arrow, boots, shield, turret and mine are identifiable; no icon is clipped.

At 32 px all art silhouettes fit. The bow and turret have finer, dimmer detail, while resource shapes and warm cleave/missile accents remain distinguishable. Some contact-sheet ID captions truncate; these captions are review labels, not runtime labels.

gameplay.notes: These are generated art/layout sheets, not Godot captures. Runtime and requested MCP inspection are recorded with the game-side Issue #52 work; no MCP runtime result is claimed for this source-art review.

known_deviations: This static art package does not include Godot runtime screenshots. Its generated layouts are explicitly labeled as non-engine evidence.
The historical reference is a candidate and includes older labels such as Sniper/Overclock; current strips follow the Issue #52 Eagle Eye/Nuke mapping.

feedback_resolution.finding: Manifest schema compatibility detected in consolidation
feedback_resolution.root_cause: Asset revision 2 was written into the schema version field, but validate_asset requires schema version 1.
feedback_resolution.verification: validate_all passed after retaining schema version 1 and storing asset_revision 2; build refreshed evidence and the six declared sheets were directly reinspected.
